scope: Fresh GitHub main clone; connected local web preview at 430 × 932. Browser evidence only; not a native iPhone test or launch certification.

screens.name: Home
screens.observed: Local court, live count, weekly court hours, locals, Check In, Here Now, Up Next, hourly activity and recent activity. Court arrow opens the full court screen.
screens.next: Before launch, make an active visit at a different court visible and avoid an ambiguous Check In that silently switches courts. This is an assessment; exact UI implementation awaits owner direction.

screens.name: Court detail
screens.observed: Live, Games, Players, Week and Info navigation. Live feed loads actual activity. Week shows planned visits and scheduled game markers.
screens.next: Week uses two-hour groups starting at 7 AM; Schedule uses one-hour slots. Clearer grouping labels are optional polish, not evidence of a timezone bug.

screens.name: Schedule
screens.observed: Rolling seven-day grid, court selector, hourly counts and game markers. Selecting a populated slot reveals the existing Going state and attendee. Add Times and Schedule Game entry points are present.
screens.next: Attendance, game creation, cancellation and multi-user updates still need write-path testing; viewing these screens does not verify those operations.

screens.name: Compete
screens.observed: Populated local leaderboard with ELO. Log Game opens sport, court, date, opponent and score controls; submission is disabled until required input is supplied.
screens.next: Score submission and opponent review were not executed.

screens.name: Explore
screens.observed: List mode loads the local court and another court as metric cards. After refreshing the browser, Map mode renders map tiles, court markers, zoom controls and Find Nearest Court. The earlier missing-key message was a stale preview, not a confirmed app defect.
screens.next: Native map gestures, location permission and nearest-court behavior still require testing; no location permission was granted during this pass.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.observed: Profile stats and activity load; Inbox contains challenge states. Settings is reachable. Log Out produced no visible confirmation in web; source uses React Native Alert.alert.
screens.next: Web logout is a known owner-accepted limitation below the launch line. Owner separately reports native account deletion verified.

screens.name: Fresh onboarding
screens.observed: Fresh test account creation and onboarding completed. Walked welcome, username/sport, Conroe city search, Sand Branch court selection, auto check-in explanation and Not Now for alerts. Landed on Home showing Sand Branch as the saved local court.
screens.next: Native location, background auto check-in and push permission prompts were not exercised. Owner screenshots provide additional native evidence but are not an independent retest.

decisions.title: Start from a fresh app clone
decisions.answer: Use GitHub main as the starting point. Do not sync, merge or import older local working copies or their environment files.

decisions.title: App work comes first
decisions.answer: Document the current state in a bounded pass. Preserve useful interactive mocks; avoid turning documentation into a separate prerequisite project.

decisions.title: Keep working evidence outside app source
decisions.answer: Raw screenshots and drafts live in a sibling workbench folder. Publish concise, portable findings and decisions in the shared documentation site. Never publish credentials.

decisions.title: Prioritize the launch
decisions.answer: Assess audit recommendations against the actual app and current guidance. Clearly distinguish critical launch work from improvements that can go below the line.

decisions.title: Known browser logout is below the launch line
decisions.answer: Owner confirms browser logout is a known limitation and not important to the native end product. Do not make repairing web logout a launch prerequisite.

questions.title: Confirm the smallest active-visit clarity change
questions.detail: Owner supplied a mock with a persistent checked-in court header. Proposal: always expose the actual active court and Check Out; distinguish saved local court, browsed court and active visit; make switching an active visit to a different court explicit. Multiple saved courts and navigation changes are separate scope.

questions.title: Native onboarding permission coverage
questions.detail: Browser walkthrough reached all onboarding steps using city search, Sand Branch court selection and Not Now for alerts. Auto check-in explicitly requires the App Store app. Native permission and background behavior remain separate device checks.
questions.status: Browser flow inspected; native scope separate

launch.title: Active visit can disappear from Home’s apparent state
launch.detail: Owner encountered the confusion after visiting another court. Source confirms Home compares checkedInCourtId only with localCourt.id (HomeScreen.tsx:103–104) and its Check In calls checkIn(localCourt.id) (:124). AppContext.tsx:610–634 routes this through the atomic check_in operation, which closes the previous court visit. This explains a plausible accidental switch, but does not prove the cause or timing of the owner’s notification. Make the active court visible and switching intentional before launch. A full navigation redesign is not required.

launch.title: Core write paths and native behavior
launch.detail: Check-in, attendance, game creation/review, push, location permissions and purchases remain outside this browser walkthrough. There is not enough evidence here to call the app launch-ready.

launch.title: Unifying Week and Schedule labels
launch.detail: Different aggregation is confirmed in source. Better range labels can reduce confusion; the observed difference alone is not a critical defect.

launch.title: A full project dashboard rebuild
launch.detail: This compact record supports app work now. Rich reply persistence, a new project-management backend and replacing every mock are not required to start the card work.

launch.title: Avoid reopening completed work without contrary evidence
launch.detail: Owner reports native deletion, court creation and Mapbox working. Treat these as owner evidence rather than independent retests. Browser Map rendering was also independently observed.

history.event: Owner chose a fresh GitHub clone and separate app/docs/workbench folders.
Public runtime configuration saved locally; connected preview launched from fresh app main.
Populated account inspected across Home, Court, Schedule, Compete, Explore, Profile and Settings. Fresh onboarding remains blocked by sign-in.

Owner supplied mobile evidence and described confusing an active visit with the saved local court. Source inspection confirmed the cross-court Home state mismatch. Owner marked browser logout below the launch line and reported deletion, Mapbox and court creation verified.
Fresh account created successfully after the earlier sign-in rejection. Onboarding progressed through name/sport, city search/court selection, native auto check-in explanation and alert choice.
Verified onboarding completion: fresh account landed on Home with the selected Sand Branch local court. No active visit, game, challenge or subscription was created.

verification_reports.limits: Reported as verified by the owner; not independently rerun in this browser pass. Screenshots include onboarding, court detail and the Apple sandbox subscription sheet. The subscription sheet alone does not prove entitlement completion or restore behavior.
